name: Shyft AI Strategy Blueprint
headline: AI Automation Agency Builder: Launch Your AI
short_description: This skill enables users to create and grow their own AI automation agency from scratch. It provides a step-by-step guide to launch, scale, and expand a business focusing on AI services for non-technical industries.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The AI Automation Agency Builder skill is designed to empower users to establish and grow their own AI automation agency from the ground up. This beginner-friendly skill provides a comprehensive, step-by-step guide that walks users through the process of launching, scaling, and expanding a business focused on delivering AI services to non-technical industries. By utilizing this skill, users can effectively navigate the complexities of starting an AI agency without requiring prior technical experience. One of the key benefits of the AI Automation Agency Builder is its focus on practical implementation, allowing users to potentially save significant time in the initial setup and operational phases of their business. While specific time savings are not quantified, the structured approach provided by the skill can help streamline the learning curve and accelerate the path to revenue generation. This skill is particularly beneficial for entrepreneurs, product managers, and AI practitioners looking to tap into the growing demand for AI solutions in small businesses that may lack technical expertise. Practical use cases for this skill include starting an AI automation agency with no prior technical experience, scaling an AI business to achieve monthly revenues of $10,000 and beyond, and targeting non-technical small businesses with tailored AI solutions. For instance, an aspiring entrepreneur could utilize the skill to create a service that automates customer support for local businesses, thereby enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. The implementation of this skill typically requires a commitment of 2+ hours, making it accessible for busy professionals. Incorporating the AI Automation Agency Builder into an AI-first workflow allows users to leverage automation tools effectively, ensuring that their agency can operate efficiently and meet client needs promptly. This skill is an essential resource for anyone looking to enter the AI automation space, providing the foundational knowledge and actionable insights necessary to succeed in a competitive market.
Starting an AI automation agency with no prior technical experience
Scaling an AI business to $10,000 monthly and beyond
Targeting non-technical small businesses with AI solutions
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
You are an AI entrepreneur ready to start your own agency. Fill in the placeholders to outline your business plan: 

1. Define your niche: [NICHE] (e.g., plumbers, home cleaners)
2. Choose an AI system to offer: [SYSTEM] (e.g., AI receptionist, social media DM agent)
3. Develop your marketing strategy: 
   - Identify four sub-niches: [SUB_NICHE_1], [SUB_NICHE_2], [SUB_NICHE_3], [SUB_NICHE_4] 
   - Create a cold email campaign targeting these sub-niches
4. Set your pricing model: 
   - Monthly retainer: [MONTHLY_RETAINER]
   - Upfront setup fee: [SETUP_FEE]
5. Plan for proof and testimonials:
   - Obtain client testimonials: [TESTIMONIAL_PLAN] 
   - Create case studies with results: [RESULTS_PLAN]
```
Copy

```
1. Define your niche: Plumbers
2. Choose an AI system to offer: AI receptionist
3. Develop your marketing strategy: 
   - Identify four sub-niches: Residential plumbers, commercial plumbers, emergency plumbing services, plumbing installation specialists 
   - Create a cold email campaign targeting these sub-niches
4. Set your pricing model: 
   - Monthly retainer: $2,500
   - Upfront setup fee: $5,000
5. Plan for proof and testimonials:
   - Obtain client testimonials: Reach out to initial clients for video testimonials
   - Create case studies with results: Document initial setups and results highlighting reduced response times and increased customer satisfaction
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
